Name: 300 Swedish Birds
MetaDescription: A checklist for birders in Sweden. Tick off species, log where and when you saw them, and compare lists with friends.
Headline: Every bird you see in Sweden, in one list.
Lede: Tick off species as you see them, note the place and the date, and watch your year list grow. Free, in your browser.

Features.title: Lists for every goal
Features.text: Start from the 300 most common Swedish birds or build your own list: a year list, a list for your garden, or one for a single trip.

Features.title: Where and when
Features.text: Each sighting keeps its date and position, and is placed in the right county and municipality automatically. Export everything as CSV whenever you like.

Features.title: Bird with friends
Features.text: Share a list and compare it with friends' lists species by species, or set up a competition for a season.
